# Massive Designer

> Massive's on-brand images, made from a link: put the values in the URL and it returns the finished JPG. No sign-in, no key.

## How to make an image

1. Pick an image. Templates are made to be filled in; the other images are finished designs that can be re-rendered with changes.
2. Build the link: `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=<id>&<param>=<value>&…`
   - Use only that image's params. Leave a param out to keep its default.
   - URL-encode every value (a space is %20).
   - Text: as it should read, up to 300 characters. Select: one of the listed values. Toggle: true or false.
   - Photo: a public link to the image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or SVG, up to 15 MB), not a page that shows it. Share pages from Unsplash, Google Drive or Dropbox (`dl=0`) won't work.
3. If the person attached the photo or has it on their computer, leave the photo param out and tell them: "Open the link and paste or drop your photo into the Photo field."
4. Give the person the link, as a plain link (not a markdown image). It opens the design in Massive Designer, filled in; they check the preview and click Download JPG.
5. For the finished JPG straight away, the same params work on `https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/<id>.jpg?<param>=<value>&…` (photo links only; `scale=1` for 1×, `download=1` to download). You don't need to open it yourself: it renders when the person clicks it.

Example: "A blog banner called 'Hotel Prices Without a Browser' with this photo: https://example.com/hotel.jpg"
- Link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=blog-banner&headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg
- JPG: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg?headline=Hotel%20Prices%20Without%20a%20Browser&photo=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fhotel.jpg

Search every image: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?q=<words> (add &format=json for JSON). One image's details: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/images?id=<id>.

## Templates

### Blog banner (template)

id `blog-banner` · 1376×768 · content · template

The joinmassive.com blog post banner (Sanity's Banner field), 1376×768: a photo with a dark wash from the left, the Massive logo and the headline in red-light. Use Strong wash for a bright photo. The photo recipe is in assets/photo-prompt.txt.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "Seltz: A Web Search API for LLMs". About 60 characters
- `position`: Headline position. One of `middle` (Middle), `bottom` (Bottom); default `middle`.
- `wash`: Wash. One of `standard` (Standard (dark photo)), `strong` (Strong (bright photo)); default `standard`. Strong for bright photos

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/blog-banner.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=blog-banner
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/blog-banner/thumb.jpg

### Hiring: Photo (template)

id `hiring-photo-square` · 1080×1080 · hiring · template

The square hiring post: “We’re hiring” and the role on a red brush stroke, on a cream wash beside the photo, and a handwritten note with an arrow. Fill in the role and the note, and pick one of the hiring photos (../_hiring/) or upload one; ../_hiring/hiring.js fits the wash, the photo and the arrow to it.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image, or one of the design's photos by name: `Home office`, `Standing call`, `Window seat (SF)`, `Standing desk`, `Coffee at the desk`, `At an event`, `Leaning back`, `Home lab`, `Café`, `On the sofa`, `Balcony abroad`, `Kitchen at sunrise`, `Hammock`; default: the design's own. Pick one of the hiring photos, or upload your own: subject on the right, an empty bright left side.
- `headline`: Headline. Text; default "We’re hiring".
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Writer in Residence". On the red stroke; up to two lines, it shrinks to fit.
- `aside`: Handwritten note. Text; default "Pajamas: approved.". A short joke about the photo, like “Socks: mismatched.”; the arrow points into the photo.
- `showAside`: Show the note. True or false; default true.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/hiring-photo-square.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=hiring-photo-square
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/hiring-photo-square/thumb.jpg

### Prague Crawl 2027: speaker card

id `prague-crawl-2027-speaker` · 1080×1080 · events · template

Announce a confirmed speaker: their photo in a gradient ring on the left, and Speaker, their name, company logo and role on the right, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). Fill in one per speaker. The default is Jason Grad as an example.

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Speaker". One or two words, in capitals: Speaker, Keynote, Panelist, Demo.
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A square portrait with the face centred, at least 900 px wide; it's cropped to a circle.
- `name`: Name. Text; default "Jason Grad". Full name, in capitals. Wraps to two lines and shrinks to fit.
- `logo`: Company logo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The company's logo for dark backgrounds (white or colour on black), PNG or SVG, wider than tall.
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Co-Founder & CEO". Job title only; the logo shows the company. Up to about 40 characters.
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027".
- `venue`: Venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague".

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/prague-crawl-2027-speaker.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=prague-crawl-2027-speaker
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/prague-crawl-2027-speaker/thumb.jpg

### Prague Crawl 2027: sponsor welcome

id `prague-crawl-2027-sponsor` · 1080×1080 · events · template

Welcome a sponsor as they sign: Sponsored by, their logo straight on the black, and their tier, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). It's the LinkedIn co-post (Platinum, Gold) or mention (Silver, Bronze) from the deck's benefits table (scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html). The default, Apify as a Gold sponsor, is only an example.

Params:
- `eyebrow`: Eyebrow. Text; default "Sponsored by". Two or three words, in capitals.
- `logo`: Sponsor logo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. The sponsor's logo for dark backgrounds (white or colour on a transparent background), PNG or SVG.
- `tier`: Tier. One of `platinum` (Platinum sponsor), `gold` (Gold sponsor), `silver` (Silver sponsor), `bronze` (Bronze sponsor), `afterparty` (Afterparty Partner), `coffee` (Coffee & Lunch Partner), `none` (No tier line); default `gold`. The line under the logo.
- `date`: Date. Text; default "May 13, 2027".
- `venue`: Venue. Text; default "Spojka Events, Prague".

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/prague-crawl-2027-sponsor.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=prague-crawl-2027-sponsor
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/prague-crawl-2027-sponsor/thumb.jpg

### Welcome to Massive: Template (Franklin)

id `welcome-template` · 1080×1350 · team · template

A new teammate's character-sheet card over the dimmed Slack desktop, with the welcome line below: the Welcome to Massive video held still in the Milestone card's layout. Fill in a new hire's details and photo.

Params:
- `photo`: Photo. A direct https:// link to an image; default: the design's own. A portrait
- `badge`: Badge. Text; default "New hire".
- `name`: Full name. Text; default "Franklin Uche".
- `firstName`: First name. Text; default "Franklin". Used in the welcome line
- `status`: Status. Text; default "Available".
- `role`: Role. Text; default "Community Lead".
- `country`: Country. Text; default "Nigeria". In English; it picks the flag
- `hobbies`: Abilities (comma-separated, up to 5). Text; default "Playing football, Playing golf, Gardening". Each one becomes a chip
- `food`: Fuel (favourite food). Text; default "Medium rare steak and rice".
- `confetti`: Confetti. True or false; default true.

Image link (defaults): https://massive-designer.vercel.app/api/render/welcome-template.jpg
Edit link: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/images?template=welcome-template
Thumbnail: https://massive-designer.vercel.app/image-projects/welcome-template/thumb.jpg
